versions.subject: OSCD Task 1 - Privilege Escalation
versions.detection:
scbynonadmin:
    Image: '*\sc.exe'
    IntegrityLevel: 'Medium'
binpath:
    CommandLine: '*config*binPath*'
failurecommand:
    CommandLine: '*failure*command*'
condition: scbynonadmin and (binpath or failurecommand)
